text:
Priya: quick note from guerrilla testing: first-run banner gets clicked but users expect a checklist flow. They said "show me steps".
Maya: same. the left rail is discoverable but not explicit. modal forces completion but is heavy.
Sam: metrics confirm a small drop in completion after rail-only rollout. suspect CTA text.
Leo: accessibility: rail CTA contrast 3.6:1 and keyboard focus skips it. need tabindex + color fix.
Priya: copy options to A/B: "Create demo project" vs "Start setup checklist". prefer the first.
Sam: add microcopy under CTA: "Includes sample prompts  ~2 minutes".
AccessibilityBot: checklist: add role="region" + aria-label to rail, ensure tab order, and bump contrast to >=4.5:1. small CSS:
```
.entry-rail .cta { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); color: #05204a }
```
Maya: propose hybrid: keep rail default but add 3-line preview plus a "Full setup" link that opens the modal. track events: rail_cta_click, preview_expand, modal_open, rail_dismiss.
Sam: eng estimate ~3 dev days (copy + tabindex + telemetry). I'll file a ticket and attach Figma.
Priya: experiment rule: hide rail for 14 days after dismiss. persist preference for Dedicated customers.
Maya: sounds good. I'll drop the prototype and a11y notes in the ticket. Thanks!
